independence: Original snapshot, frozen target, warm-soft reference, own brief/metadata, actual original collection and all-four original native replay inspected before canonical-middle technical resources. No editor proposals or aesthetic verdicts inspected.
sourceObservations: Original is a broad low cyan-blue continuous shelf with hard rectangular crown and dark navy base; three thin parallel top bars read as schematic scratches. The closed east end has a thin dark horizontal strip.

Native authored S has one W port at X=-0.5, normal (-1,0,0), exact six-point rock-shelf section; path ends at X=0.34. Ground is the finite rectangle X[-0.5,0.34], Y[-0.45,0.45], Z=0; no whole-cell opaque floor rule.

Actual full geometry bounds are X[-0.5,0.358999997], Y[-0.449999988,0.449999988], Z[0,0.449000001]. The east trim extends above ground beyond core closure; it is neither a second port nor a ground extension. No armature, actions, sockets, shape keys or animation owners.
targetObservations: Target proposes a cohesive cyan stone shelf with large gently uneven interlocking plate volumes, softened corners, broad pale-cyan edge reflections and controlled deeper-blue crevices.
Small purple/teal pebbles and restrained pits add personality; they are optional design cues, not required counts. The large bright top remains the readable focus.

Target side depth and footprint appearance cannot override registered low height, exact finite support, fixed camera or native west section. Its highlight direction, cyan edge halo and many fine waterlike veins are not technical requirements.
Warm-soft reference suggests broad lit planes, readable midtones and smooth transitions with deliberate edges, rather than simply increasing gloss.
rankedVisibleOutcomes: Replace rigid slab and line-bar appearance with rounded, weighty, deliberately composed stone forms while clearly reading as one low shelf end.
Keep the native join quiet and continuous with its family; make the exposed end look intentionally finished.
Use a coherent cyan/blue palette with controlled depth, broad soft highlights and sparse detail that survives cell128 and phone32.
